data.name: Chandler
data.gender_notes: Chandler is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Old English, the name Chandler is derived from the word 'ceandel,' which translates to 'wanderer.' In another interpretation, it comes from the word 'can' or 'chan,' meaning 'tankard' or 'container,' and 'daler,' meaning 'bearer.'. The name Chandler carries the meaning “Wanderer or Tankard Bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Chandler usually hope their child will grow to embody wanderer or tankard bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: צ'נדלר
in_hebrew.meaning: מוכר נרות או אחראי על כלי הקודש
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם צ'נדלר מקורו במילה האנגלית שפירושה מוכר נרות או אחראי על כלי הקודש. הוא קשור למילה העברית 'נר' ומשמעותו היא אחד שמטפל או מוכר כלי קודש, במיוחד נרות, בבית המקדש או במשכן.

in_greek.name: Τσάντλερ
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Τσάντλερ προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὴν ἀγγλική λέξη ποὺ σημαίνει κηροπώλης ἤ λειτουργός. Ἐτυμολογεῖται ἀπὸ τὸ γαλλικό 'chandelier', ποὺ σημαίνει κανδήλα, καὶ συνδέεται μὲ τὴν ὑπηρεσία τῶν ἁγίων λειτουργιῶν καὶ τὴν προετοιμασία τῶν κεριών γιὰ τὴν λατρεία.

in_latin.name: Chandler
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Chandler derivatur a voce Anglica quae significat candelabri vel officiorum sacrorum administrator. Etymologia eius radix in Gallia invenitur, ubi 'chandelier' significat candelabrum, et refertur ad curam et administrationem rerum sacrarum, praesertim candelarum, in ecclesia.

in_english.meaning: a person who sells or makes candles
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Chandler is derived from the Old English words 'candle' and '-er', signifying a person who sells or makes candles. Historically, a chandler was an important figure in medieval communities, providing essential lighting for homes and churches. The name symbolizes illumination and guidance, reflecting the spiritual light of Christ. In modern times, Chandler is used as a given name, symbolizing a beacon of hope and faith.
